answer: The harbor cap is applied at intake and zephyr shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a cedar tag. That is 14 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
